import json,sys,fcntl,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import warp as wp
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts/studies'))
import fluxbridge_shared_jk_stability as impl
from fluxbridge_shared_jk_full_study import arrays
from fluxbridge_shared_jk_consumers import scene
from fluxbridge_shell_acceptance import timed
p=Path('/tmp/fluxbridge-fp32-stability-20261026');report=dict(rows=[],source=Path(__file__).read_text())
with open('/tmp/fluxbridge-gpu.lock','a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX);wp.init();device=wp.get_device('cuda:0');api=impl.functions('floatpair-inline');n=1048576
 for mixed in [False,True]:
  v=scene(mixed);rng=np.random.default_rng(852);ids=rng.integers(0,len(v),n,dtype=np.int32) if mixed else np.zeros(n,int)
  if mixed:
   edges=(v[:,1:]-v[:,0,None,:]).transpose(0,2,1);q=v[ids,0]+np.einsum('nij,nj->ni',edges[ids],rng.uniform(-.5,1.5,(n,3)));h=rng.uniform(.3,2,n)
  else:q=.2+rng.uniform(-.015,.015,(n,3));h=np.ones(n)
  g,static=timed(lambda:impl.prepare_geometry(v,device,'floatpair-inline'),device,1)
  args,out=arrays(api,g,q,h,ids,device)
  action=lambda:wp.launch(api.kernel,n,inputs=args,device=device,block_dim=256)
  action();wp.synchronize_device(device);ref=out.numpy()
  with wp.ScopedCapture(device=device) as cap:action()
  wp.capture_launch(cap.graph);wp.synchronize_device(device);equal=bool(np.array_equal(ref,out.numpy()))
  def transfer():
   ins,dst=arrays(api,g,q,h,ids,device);wp.launch(api.kernel,n,inputs=ins,device=device,block_dim=256);return dst.numpy()
  _,timing=timed(transfer,device,3)
  row=dict(mixed=mixed,pairs=n,static_setup=static,static_bytes=g.data.capacity+g.data_low.capacity+g.edges.capacity,
   input_output_bytes=sum(x.capacity for x in args if isinstance(x,wp.array)),graph_bitwise_equal=equal,upload_kernel_readback=timing,
   kernel_properties=wp.get_cuda_kernel_properties(api.kernel,device))
  assert equal;report['rows'].append(row);print(row,flush=True)
report['source_sha256']={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in [Path(impl.__file__),Path(__file__)]}
(p/'transfer-graph.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

conclusions: Compensating coefficient sums/products alone fails; recurrence/geometry seed accuracy also matters
Two-float arithmetic with ordinary fp32 log/atan seeds fixes canonical arithmetic but leaves transformed cases failing
Range-reduced two-float log/atan removes seed errors down to the rounded-geometry replay floor
Split-float static geometry preserves near-orthogonal frame consistency; it passes all 116 independent cases without device fp64
Final moment/tensor accumulation can remain ordinary fp32 at these finite gates; narrower protection is still needed for speed
Ten outputs on eight broad mixed pairs still exceed 1e-5 against original fp64-valued query/support inputs; these input quantization differences are retained, not hidden
At the actual fp32 query/support values, every broad output passes; worst inline mixed error is 1.400e-6, independently confirmed at its worst case
Explicit inlining and isolated Warp compilation units stabilize the final 254-register, zero-local-traffic variant; non-inlined variants spill
Final prototype uses no device fp64 arithmetic; its 75k fp32 arithmetic FLOPs/pair and high register count leave a substantial gap to raw fp32 speed
limitations: Two-float arithmetic is about 48-bit working precision implemented with fp32 instructions; this is not ordinary single-word fp32 accuracy closure
Static geometry preparation remains host fp64, split into high/low fp32 arrays; split geometry storage equals the fp64 geometry footprint
Only the W6 tetrahedron baseline contract is investigated, not every production kernel or surface/FEM request
Pointwise math checks cover finite normal arithmetic and positive normal log(1+z) inputs; the helper is an experimental private implementation, not a generic arithmetic package
Finite fixture/sample acceptance does not certify arbitrary ill-conditioning, underflow/overflow ranges or a universal error bound
Most broad rounded-input reference values come from validated fp64 evaluation; five hard cases have independent signed-cone checks
CUDA measurements serialized with unlocked clocks/caches and desktop activity; profile replays and warm medians differ and are reported separately
Experimental code only; production dispatch, ordinary 2D solid/fibre providers and browser implementations unchanged
No warpSPH/Core/Integrator changes or Stage 5 integration
next_step: Replace cancellation-prone expanded radial/face divided differences with well-conditioned local/basis evaluations, using the paired core as a precision control; narrow wide state further and retain the same independent 1e-5 gate and matched CUDA measurements before considering selective fp64
